Title: Color Converter
Description: Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK, get a 9-step shades palette and check WCAG contrast between two colors in your browser.
Keywords: color converter, HEX to RGB, RGB to HSL, CMYK color, color picker online, CSS color converter, color code converter

Seo_Introduction: Paste a CSS color in any common notation and get the same color as HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK, ready to copy. The page also builds a palette of lighter and darker shades and checks the WCAG contrast ratio of a text and background pair.
Seo_DetailedDescription:
The format is detected automatically: `#3b82f6`, short `#38f` (the hash is optional), `rgb(59, 130, 246)` or `rgba(…)` with 0–255 or percentage channels, `hsl(217, 91%, 60%)` with an optional `deg` unit, and `cmyk(76%, 47%, 0%, 4%)`. Space-separated CSS syntax such as `rgb(59 130 246 / 50%)` works as well; the alpha value is accepted but ignored, because the outputs have no transparency. Invalid or out-of-range values are flagged with an error instead of being guessed. You can also pick a color with the native color picker.

The shades palette keeps the hue and saturation of the current color and steps the lightness from 10% to 90% in nine tiles; clicking a tile makes it the current color. The contrast checker takes a text and a background color and reports the ratio together with the four WCAG 2.x thresholds: AA 4.5:1 and AAA 7:1 for normal text, AA 3:1 and AAA 4.5:1 for large text.

All conversions are plain JavaScript formulas running on the page — nothing is uploaded. CMYK is the simple device-independent formula without an ICC profile, so use it for rough print hints, not for prepress proofs. HSL and CMYK values are rounded to whole numbers, so converting them back may differ from the original by one unit.
Seo_Examples:
**HEX to everything**: `#3b82f6` gives `rgb(59, 130, 246)`, `hsl(217, 91%, 60%)` and `cmyk(76%, 47%, 0%, 4%)`.

**HSL to HEX**: `hsl(0, 100%, 50%)` converts to `#FF0000`, as does `cmyk(0%, 100%, 100%, 0%)`.

**Contrast check**: grey `#777777` text on a white `#ffffff` background has a ratio of `4.48:1` — it passes AA for large text (3:1) but fails AA for normal text (4.5:1).

**Default pair**: the preset `#1e3a8a` on `#ffffff` reaches `10.36:1` and passes all four WCAG levels.
Seo_HowToSteps:
### Step 1: Enter a color
Type or paste a value into **Manual Input** (HEX, rgb(), hsl() or cmyk()) and press **Convert** or Enter, or choose a color with **Color Picker**.

### Step 2: Copy the format you need
In **Converted Formats**, click the copy button next to HEX, RGB, HSL or CMYK.

### Step 3: Pick a shade
In **Shades Palette**, click a tile to use a lighter or darker variant of the same hue as the current color.

### Step 4: Check contrast
In **Contrast Checker**, set **Foreground Color** and **Background Color** and read the ratio and the AA/AAA results.
Seo_Tips:
- The `#` is optional and three-digit shorthand works: `38f` is read as `#3388FF`.
- Hue may be written with or without `deg`; saturation and lightness need values from 0 to 100.
- Values outside the valid range (for example `rgb(300, 0, 0)`) are rejected instead of being silently clamped.
- For body text aim for at least 4.5:1; 3:1 is enough only for large text (24 px, or 18.66 px bold).
- Do not rely on the CMYK output for print production — ask your printer for values based on their ICC profile.
